description.zh:
IPC设备的设备名称。
您可以在物联网平台控制台的**设备**页查看**DeviceName**。
><notice> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入**ProductKey**。
></notice>
description.en:
The device name of the IPC device.
You can view the **DeviceName** on the **Devices** page of the IoT platform console.
><notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify **ProductKey**.
></notice>.

description.zh:
IPC设备的设备ID。物联网平台为该设备颁发的ID，设备的唯一标识符。可调用物联网平台[QueryDeviceDetail](~~69594~~)查询。

><notice> 如果传入该参数，则无需传入**ProductKey**和**DeviceName**。**IotId**作为设备唯一标识符，和**ProductKey**与**DeviceName**的组合是一一对应的关系。如果您同时传入**IotId**和**ProductKey**与**DeviceName**的组合，则以**IotId**为准。
></notice>
description.en:
The device ID of the IPC device. This is the unique identifier issued by the IoT platform for the device. You can call the [QueryDeviceDetail](~~69594~~) operation of the IoT platform to query the device ID.

><notice> If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify **ProductKey** or **DeviceName**. **IotId** is the globally unique identifier of a device and corresponds to a combination of **ProductKey** and **DeviceName** on a one-to-one basis. If you specify **IotId** together with **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**, **IotId** takes precedence.
></notice>.

description.zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。

><notice>
- 若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
- 若无<props="intl"><ph>**实例概览**页面或</ph></props>ID值，则无需传入。

></notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见[实例概述](~~356505~~)。
description.en:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page of the IoT platform console.

><notice>
- If an ID value exists, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If the <props="intl"><ph>**Overview** page or the </ph></props>ID value does not exist, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

description.zh:
IPC设备所属产品的ProductKey。
您可以在物联网平台控制台**产品**页查看或调用[QueryProductList](~~69271~~)查看当前账号下所有产品的信息。
><notice> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入**DeviceName**。
></notice>
description.en:
The ProductKey of the product to which the IPC device belongs.
You can view the ProductKey on the **Products** page of the IoT platform console or call the [QueryProductList](~~69271~~) operation to query information about all products under the current account.
><notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify **DeviceName**.
></notice>.

The stream type. Valid values:
- **0** (default): main stream.
- **1**: sub stream.

descriptions.zh:
## 使用说明

- 调用该接口前，您需要在IPC设备端实现标识符为**StopPushStreaming**的停止直播物模型服务。若未在IPC设备端实现该服务，或IPC设备收到该服务调用后未正常响应，则IPC设备不会停止推流。物模型的详细信息，请参见[什么是物模型](~~73727~~)。
- 当IPC设备端无人观看时，无需额外调用该接口，物联网平台会自动触发停止设备推流。
- 触发录像事件的过程中，调用该接口会造成录像文件间断，请您谨慎使用。
descriptions.en:
## Operation description

- Before you invoke this operation, you must implement the Thing Specification Language (TSL) service identified by **StopPushStreaming** on the IPC device. If this service is not implemented on the IPC device, or the IPC device does not return a normal response after receiving the service invocation, the IPC device does not stop pushing streams. For more information about TSL, see [What is a TSL model?](~~73727~~).
- When no one is watching the IPC device, you do not need to invoke this operation. The IoT platform automatically triggers the device to stop pushing streams.
- If you invoke this operation during a recording event procedure, the recording file may be interrupted. Use this operation with caution.
